highlights: Google 发布 Gemini Decisions API，用 Gemini Decision 1 在一次前向中为最多 1,000 个封闭集问题打分并返回置信度，面向路由、策略检查和内容评分。
华为开源 MXFP4 W4A4 后训练量化方法 MACaQ，逐层独立量化，Qwen3-32B 在 vLLM 上相对纯 MXFP4 仅增加 2.3% 端到端开销。
Tree-Ising 把语言模型权重修复建模为 BF16 位级 Ising/QUBO 优化问题，在 MATH-500 上以 54.6% 超过 agent 直接改权重的 51.7%，且只需 4 次前向、零 LLM token。

items.title: Google 发布 Gemini Decisions API
items.summary: Google 推出新的 Gemini Decisions API 端点，由 Gemini Decision 1 模型驱动，可在单次前向中对文本、图像、音频、视频和 PDF 做封闭集判断。每次请求可带最多 256K tokens 输入和 1,000 个独立问题，返回概率与 0 到 1 的置信度，可直接用于工具选择、模型路由、策略检查和内容评分。

evidence.quote: Today, we’re introducing the Gemini Decisions API, a new endpoint for fast, closed-set decisions powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model (gemini-decision-1), available through the Gemini API in Google AI Studio .
The Decisions API gives you purpose-built primitives for bounded choices like tool selection, policy checks, model routing, and context grading.
You can pass one multimodal input across text, images, audio, video, and PDFs (up to 256K tokens) along with up to 1,000 independent questions.

Rather than generating answer text token by token, Gemini Decision 1 scores your candidate options in a single forward pass, returning probabilities and confidence scores in 150-250 ms end-to-end latency at $0.10 per 1M input tokens with zero output tokens billed.

Every answer includes a confidence score (from 0 to 1) so your code can route ambiguous cases to a fallback or human reviewer: noul (Yes/No): Estimates the probability that a yes/no condition holds, with optional true and false description criteria.

items.title: 华为开源 W4A4 量化方法 MACaQ
items.summary: 华为 HUAWEI Computing Systems Lab 开源 MACaQ，一种 MXFP4 W4A4 后训练量化方法，对每个线性层独立处理，用在线 block-Hadamard 变换激活并把逆变换吸收进权重。它在 Qwen3-32B 的 vLLM 推理中相对纯 MXFP4 只增加 2.3% 端到端开销，并在 64 分钟、仅用 32.5GB GPU RAM 的条件下完成 122B 参数模型量化。

evidence.quote: We introduce MACaQ, an MXFP4 W4A4 post-training quantization method that treats every linear layer independently.
MACaQ applies a per-channel scale and a block-Hadamard transform online to each layer's activations, while absorbing the corresponding inverse transforms into its weights.
Retaining these transforms online avoids cross-layer dependencies and enables a simple streaming implementation of the quantization process, in which only one layer must reside in memory at a time.
Despite executing the activation transforms at inference time, MACaQ adds only 2.3% end-to-end overhead over pure MXFP4 on Qwen3-32B in vLLM .

We further apply MACaQ without architecture-specific modifications to an image diffusion model , illustrating the generality of its layer-local design and show quantization of a 122B parameter model in 64 minutes, using only 32.5GB GPU RAM.
My team at Huawei-CSL is open sourcing 🐵 MACAQ, the quantizer we’ve been using internally over the past few months.
Code is available here https://github.com/huawei-csl/MACaQ under the Apache 2.0 license!

items.title: Tree-Ising 用位级 Ising 优化修复模型权重
items.summary: Tree-Ising 把语言模型的权重修复写成 BF16 参数上的稀疏 Ising/QUBO 问题，每个输出行独立求解，可用 GPU 上的模拟退火或模拟分岔完成。在两个被修复层上它在 MATH-500 得到 54.6%，高于 agent 直接改动的 51.7%，且只需 4 次前向请求、零 LLM token，GPU 时间约 $0.90。

evidence.quote: Our method, Tree-Ising, casts this repair as a sparse discrete optimization problem over the model's own BF16 weights .
We decompose this objective exactly into independent QUBO (Ising) problems, one per output row , which we solve on a GPU using simulated annealing or quantum-inspired simulated bifurcation .
On the agent's two layers, Tree-Ising achieves 54.6% on MATH-500 , outperforming the agent's edit (51.7%) under the same evaluation protocol, while the base model scores 7.9% as reported.
The simulated bifurcation solver yields a statistically indistinguishable repair at 55.1%.
It requires only four forward-pass requests and zero LLM tokens, with the annealing recipe costing about $0.90 in GPU time.

items.title: WaveGen 实现端到端文本到波形生成
items.summary: WaveGen 是完全端到端的扩散式文本到波形框架，通过 Spectral Forcing 在单一模型内联合学习频谱轨迹与波形轨迹，不依赖神经音频编解码器、Mel-spectrogram vocoder、VAE 潜变量模型或时长预测器等外部模块。作者同时验证了从 0.1B 到 0.6B 参数规模的扩展性，并在 Seed-en 上达到 WER 1.47、SIM 0.75。

evidence.quote: Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash This work proposes WaveGen, a fully end-to-end diffusion-based text-to-waveform framework based on Spectral Forcing , which jointly learns an internal spectral trajectory and the target waveform trajectory within a single model, enabling direct end-to-end

Unlike recent TTS pipelines , WaveGen does not rely on separately trained or externally decoded intermediate representations, such as neural audio codecs , Mel-spectrogram vocoders , or VAE-based latent models .
In addition, WaveGen performs internal text-speech alignment within a single model, eliminating the need for external alignment modules such as duration predictors .

To preserve a truly end-to-end formulation, our framework further avoids dependence on self-supervised representations , such as BERT-based text embeddings and Wav2Vec 2.0-based semantic representations , as well as semantic distillation methods for training optimization.
We further validate the scalability of end-to-end TTS models by scaling the model size from 0.1B to 0.6B parameters.
In particular, WaveGen achieves a WER of 1.47 and a SIM of 0.75 on the Seed-en benchmark.

items.title: Tether 发布端侧 Agent 模型 BotPsy
items.summary: Tether AI Research 发布 BotPsy，一款基于 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的 0.8B 参数模型，面向函数调用和端侧 Agent 工作流，覆盖搜索、旅行、电商、设备控制、日历与邮件等场景。作者称其在六项工具使用与 Agent 基准上超过所有不超过 1.2B 参数的对比模型，权重将以 Apache 2.0 许可发布，提供 bf16、Q8、Q4 三种精度及 GGUF 文件。

evidence.quote: Tether AI Research introduces BotPsy , a 0.8B-parameter model introduce BotPsy , a 0.8B-parameter model designed for function calling and agentic workflows, built on top of Qwen3.5-0.8B and suitable for on-device deployment.

BotPsy is a "personal assistant" that uses tools to perform a variety of simple tasks for the user, in domains such as web search & research, travel & lifestyle, commerce & finance, business & customer operations, device & vehicle control, files & documents, calendar, and email & messaging.
BotPsy achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) tool-use and agentic performance for its size, outperforming every model of up to 1.2B parameters that we tested (Figures 1 and 2).

Best agent in its category: BotPsy outperforms leading models in the ≤1.2B-parameter weight class (Qwen3.5-0.8B-Think, LFM2.5-1.2B-Think, MiniCPM5-1B-Think) on all six tool-use and agentic benchmarks: BFCL v4, ACEBench, τ-bench, ToolSandbox, Claw-Eval and BrowseComp-Plus.
Open-source and ready to use: BotPsy will be released with open weights under the Apache 2.0 license for research and educational use.
It will be available in three precisions (bf16, Q8, Q4), as Hugging Face safetensors and as GGUF files for the QVAC SDK and llama.cpp.

items.title: Zyphra 发布端侧语音模型 ZONOS3-Mini

items.title: DeepMind 发布 DNA 模型 AlphaGenome 2
items.summary: Google DeepMind 推出 AlphaGenome 2，这是一个以特定生物条件为输入的条件模型，可预测 DNA 序列及其变异对具体人类细胞类型的影响，训练数据包含超过 100 million 个细胞谱。它能在新单细胞数据上直接泛化而不必重训，并在 TenK10K 数据集上识别出 30% 的因果变异，高于原版微调模型的 16%；目前通过 AlphaGenome API 提供非商业研究使用。

evidence.quote: Today, we are announcing AlphaGenome 2, our next-generation model that predicts how DNA sequences and their variations impact specific human cell types, giving scientists a powerful new tool to uncover the cellular drivers of disease.

By zooming in from broad tissue averages to individual cell types and cell states, and redesigning the model’s architecture, AlphaGenome 2 represents a step-change improvement in variant predictive performance.
Trained on more than 100 million individual cell profiles across 68 tissues, the model turns static cell atlases into a predictive engine for human genetics.
AlphaGenome 2 is available today for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API, and in private preview for commercial research.
We trained AlphaGenome 2 on both bulk and single-cell data from human and mouse samples, including over 107 million individual cell profiles.
Improved variant effect prediction On the TenK10K dataset, a large single-cell map of 28 primary immune cell types, AlphaGenome 2 reliably identified nearly twice as many causal variants (30% vs.
16%) and directional gene effects (43% vs.
23%) as the original AlphaGenome fine-tuned on single-cell data and other specialized tools.
Analyzing new cell types and states without retraining AlphaGenome 2 can also generalize to entirely new single-cell experiments without needing to be retrained.

items.title: 清华提出少步流式视频生成方法 APEX
items.summary: 清华团队把 APEX 扩展到流式视频生成，用 condition shifting 让生成器与 fake 估计器共享同一套参数，从而去掉 DMD 中独立的 fake-score 网络。在 180 秒视频上，APEX 相对 S2-Avatar 在指令遵循上获得 +30.0% 的净人工偏好，在匹配训练设置下比 DMD 少用 4.4% 峰值 GPU 显存、平均迭代时间短 9.2%。

evidence.quote: Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Few-step sampling reduces the cost of streaming video generation .
We extend APEX to streaming video by using condition shifting to estimate the velocity field of the generated distribution within the generator.
The original text condition selects generation, while a shifted condition selects fake estimation using the same parameters.
This removes the independent fake network while retaining S2-Avatar 's frozen reference teacher , Self-Replay Forcing , and perceptual regularization .
We evaluate APEX on 180-second videos using three backbone evaluations per block and a one-step spatial Refiner , with a 70-case human study and a 320-case StreamAV-Bench comparison.
Human raters favor APEX most strongly on instruction following, with +30.0% net preference, followed by consistency and video quality at +4.3% each.
Separate measurements under matched training settings show 4.4% lower peak allocated GPU memory per GPU and 9.2% shorter mean iteration time than DMD .
On 180-second videos , APEX achieves +30.0% net human preference for instruction following over S2-Avatar.
Under matched training settings, it reduces peak GPU memory by 4.4% and average iteration time by 9.2% compared with DMD.

items.title: KAIST 提出证据链接记忆系统 WikiTrace
items.summary: KAIST AI 提出的 WikiTrace 让 Agent 的每条经验都与来源轨迹和成败原因相连，Agent 在经验细节不足、彼此冲突或源自失败任务时，可沿链接下钻到原始轨迹再行动。作者在五个 Agent 基准上验证，该方法持续优于既有记忆方案与只给同样经验的基线，同时缓解记忆引发的能力退化。

evidence.quote: Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash External memory enables LLM agents to improve from experience by distilling trajectories of past tasks into concise lessons for new tasks.

However, memory can also lead to memory-induced degradation , where an agent fails on tasks it would solve without memory, often because it follows a lesson that is incorrect, or misapplies or misreads a valid one.
To address this, we introduce WikiTrace, an evidence-linked memory system designed to let agents check each lesson against its original trajectory.

Specifically, motivated by the finding that a trajectory often still holds the evidence needed to catch an erroneous lesson, WikiTrace stores each lesson as a concise insight linked to a summary of why its trajectory succeeded or failed and to the raw trajectory itself.

Then, on a new task, the agent starts from all insights and, whenever one lacks details needed to act, conflicts with another, or comes from a failed task, descends through its links with terminal tools to fill in missing details or correct the insight before acting.

We validate WikiTrace on five agentic benchmarks , showing that it consistently outperforms existing memory approaches and a baseline given the same insights alone, while also reducing memory-induced degradation .
Across five benchmarks, WikiTrace scored 3.2 points higher on average than using the same lessons alone.

items.title: RoboScript 用上下文学习机器人操作任务
items.summary: ArcheOne-AI 提出 World In-Context Learning（WICL）：冻结模型从单次演示出发，在仿真环境中排练任务，把反馈写进上下文而非权重，并冻结为 Task Memory。其 RoboScript 系统在 RoboTwin 2.0 全部 50 个任务上平均成功率达 83.4%，不做梯度更新，比最强训练式动作策略高出 20 分以上，代码已开源。

evidence.quote: Based on this insight, we propose World In-Context Learning (WICL), a paradigm in which a frozen model starts from a demonstration, rehearses the task in a world such as a simulator, and writes the feedback into its context rather than its weights.

From a single demonstration, RoboScript learns each task through rehearsal in simulation, freezes the learned knowledge as a Task Memory, and deploys the frozen memory on new scenes with data isolation that ensures every deployment input is available on a real robot.

On all 50 tasks of RoboTwin 2.0, RoboScript reaches 83.4% mean success across clean and randomized settings with one demonstration per task and no gradient updates, exceeding the strongest trained action policy by over 20 points.

The method generalizes across visual distributions, improves through reflection, scales with the foundation model, and transfers to a physical dual-arm robot through cross-embodiment memory adaptation.
With a world in the loop, a robot can learn a manipulation task in its context as well as it learns one in its weights.
All code is available.

items.title: LongCat 推出离散视觉表示模型 dNaViT
items.summary: LongCat 的 dNaViT 是一种原生分辨率的离散视觉 Transformer，在冻结的预训练编码器上用残差调制和双分支目标注入重建信息，并通过分组乘积量化扩展离散容量而不拉长空间序列。作者称它在 12 个视觉理解基准、4 个生成基准和一个图像编辑基准上达到或超过任务专用基线，可作为通用视觉 tokenizer 使用。

evidence.quote: We present dNaViT, a Discrete Native-resolution Vision Transformer that produces discrete visual primitives analogous to language tokens .
Built upon a frozen pretrained encoder , dNaViT applies lightweight residual modulation with a dual-branch objective to inject reconstruction-aware cues into semantic features.

By leveraging grouped product quantization , it scales discrete capacity without inflating spatial sequence lengths , while a balanced training recipe maintains both semantic and pixel-level information.
Consequently, dNaViT functions as a versatile discrete visual tokenizer , enabling unified encoding across downstream tasks alongside high-fidelity image decoding .
Extensive evaluations show that dNaViT matches or exceeds task-specific baselines across 12 visual understanding benchmarks, 4 generation benchmarks, and an image editing benchmark.
View arXiv page View PDF Project page Add to collection Community XiaotongLi97 Paper submitter 1 day ago We introduce dNaViT: Discrete Codes are General-Purpose Visual Representations.
Its shared discrete visual codes support high-fidelity reconstruction, visual understanding, generation, and editing.

items.title: Home Assistant 推出 HA-MCP 集成式部署
items.summary: homeassistant-ai 的 ha-mcp 让 Claude、ChatGPT 等 AI 助手配置和自动化 Home Assistant，推荐以 HA-MCP 集成方式安装，通过 HACS 或 Home Assistant 2026.11+ 的 Marketplace 装入并以进程内服务器运行。该集成替代此前 app、Docker 和 uvx/PyPI 等安装方式，同一客户端只应保留一种安装方式，否则容易出现连接卡死。

evidence.quote: Configure and automate Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants.
The recommended way to run ha-mcp is the HA-MCP integration .

It installs into Home Assistant through HACS (the built-in Marketplace on Home Assistant 2026.11+), runs the full server in-process , and works on every Home Assistant installation type — Home Assistant OS, Supervised, Container, and Core — with full feature parity.
Install the HA-MCP integration (requires Home Assistant 2026.8.0 or newer ; see compatibility details ).
On Home Assistant 2026.11 or newer , open Settings → Marketplace , accept its first-run warning, and search for HA-MCP , then Install .
Replaces other install methods: the in-process server is a complete, standalone ha-mcp install — it takes the place of the app (add-on), Docker, and uvx/PyPI (stdio) methods.
Run only one; do not run the in-process server alongside another install.
The custom component, the app, Docker/PyPI, and local stdio are independent ways to run the same server — pick one and point your AI client at that single URL.

Keeping two entries for the same server in one client (for example a local uvx --python 3.14 ha-mcp@latest entry with HOMEASSISTANT_URL / HOMEASSISTANT_TOKEN alongside an app or component URL) is a known cause of connection hangs.

items.title: Apple 评估 LLM 裁判的个性化写作风格判断
items.summary: Apple 研究比较人类标注与 judge-LLM 的成对排序，发现裁判质量与 MMLU 衡量的通用能力弱相关（Pearson ρ ≤ 0.2），成对比较比独立打分更稳定，而最强的 LLM 并不最可靠地复现人类评价。

evidence.quote: To this end, we generate text with four LLMs for three long-form writing tasks, collect human labels evaluating which of two responses is better, collect judge-LLM, pairwise-ranking annotations, and then compare the human and judge LLM annotations.

We find that judge quality correlates weakly with general LLM ability measured using MMLU (Pearson’s ρ ≤ 0.2) and varies by both writing task and evaluation criteria (i.e., general helpfulness versus style personalization).
We also find that LLM evaluators are more consistent and performant using paired comparisons rather than scoring responses independently.

Finally, we find that the “strongest” LLMs do not most reliably reproduce the human evaluations, which we hypothesize relates to exaggerated sensitivity to subtle details that human annotators and weaker LLMs ignore.
